summary: At c=64/65, rho=1/65 there is H~Unif(0,1) independent of a dependent leaf triplet (Z,L,V) whose full density is <=1/8 and all 1D and 2D coordinate marginals have density caps <=1, while Q=2(sqrt(c)H+sqrt(rho)Z)L+V^2 has p_Q(q)>=(4sqrt(c))^{-1} log(sqrt(c)/q) for 0<q<sqrt(c), hence unbounded density. The coefficient matrix has nonzero spectrum {-1,1,1}. This is not a QFORM counterexample because (Z,L,V) is not asserted to be an orthogonal projection of independent source coordinates; it refutes compressing the genuine leaf product-projection law to ordinary finite-dimensional density-cap metadata.
